root_cause.text: The SIT transmit path (`ipip6_tunnel_xmit()` in `net/ipv6/sit.c`) kept using a cached pointer to the inner IPv6 header after `iptunnel_handle_offloads()` could reallocate/move the skb head via `skb_header_unclone()`/`pskb_expand_head()`, leaving a stale potentially freed header pointer for later reads.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE text says `ipip6_tunnel_xmit() caches the inner IPv6 header pointer at function entry and continues using it after iptunnel_handle_offloads()`, and that `pskb_expand_head()` “may move the skb head” so “pointers into the skb header [must] be reloaded after the call”; the patch fixes this by adding `iph6 = ipv6_hdr(skb);` immediately after the offload helper succeeds.
